flags.why: This is a formal word for implementing or enforcing plans, policies or laws.
Nghiêng means slanted or leaning, rather than naming a particular Chinese-character stroke ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/nghi%C3%AAng)).
Nước tiểu is the neutral standard term for urine and is also used in ordinary conversation.
Ô nhục means shameful or disgraceful; the causative meaning in the example comes from làm ô nhục ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%B4_nh%E1%BB%A5c)).
The meaning 'to tarnish' belongs to làm ô nhục, rather than ô nhục alone ([dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/%C3%B4_nh%E1%BB%A5c)).
flags.fix: Merge this into the corrected sense 1: adj | shameful; disgraceful.

flags.why: Calling someone biến thái in this sense is a derogatory accusation of being a sexual pervert.
